info.title: D4DJ First Mix
info.synopsis: Rinku Aimoto, studentessa trasferita alla Yoba Academy, incontra il DJ in formazione Maho Akashi. Vedendo che Rinku è interessata alle attività di DJ, Maho la porta a vedere l'esibizione della più popolare unità di DJ della scuola, Peaky P-key. Consumata dall'eccitazione della performance, Rinku chiede a Maho di formare con lei un'unità di DJ

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Rinku Aimoto, transfer student to Yoba Academy, meets DJ-in-training Maho Akashi. Seeing that Rinku is interested in DJ activities, Maho takes her to see the performance of the most popular DJ unit in the school, Peaky P-key. Consumed by the excitement of the performance, Rinku asks Maho to form a DJ unit with her.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Rinku Aimoto, transfer student to Yoba Academy, meets DJ-in-training Maho Akashi. Seeing that Rinku is interested in DJ activities, Maho takes her to see the performance of the most popular DJ unit in the school, Peaky P-key. Consumed by the excitement of the performance, Rinku asks Maho to form a DJ unit with her.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Having formed a DJ unit with Rinku, Maho decides to host their first school concert. However, they are unable to attract the other students' attention. Looking for a way to change the situation, Maho comes across a school remix contest and decides to apply. She works all night and creates a remix that Rinku also likes, who then joins the contest alongside Maho. And the winner of the remix contest is...?!

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Muni Ohnaruto realises that Rinku is her childhood friend, but she is hesitant to talk to her. However, she comes across Rinku and Maho discussing flyer designs, and can't stop herself from meddling in. Rinku rejoices at the reunion and asks Muni, who is a talented illustrator, to be the VJ (Video Jockey) of the group.

episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: To gain more attention, Muni says she wants to take part in singing as well. Rei begins to compose music themed after Muni, while Rinku suggests to Rei to have a pajama party at Muni’s house to deepen their friendship.
